Coram : INDIRA BANERJEE, HRISHIKESH ROY
Employee State Insurance Act, 1948 – s.2(22) and s.2(24) – Whether ‘wages’, as defined in s.2(22) of the ESI Act would include Conveyance Allowance paid by a Company to its employees – Held: From the definition of wages in s.2(22), it is includes remunerative payments, but does not include compensatory payments – Travelling allowance including the value of travelling concession has expressly been excluded from the definition of wages, as also any payment made to an employee to reimburse or compensate for special expenses
Decision Date : 08-03-2021 | Case No : SPECIAL LEAVE PETITION (CRIMINAL) No. 811/2021 | Disposal Nature : Dismissed | Bench : 2 Judges
